name: application-cohort-retention-grid
title: Cohort Retention Grid
description: A triangular cohort-by-period retention table with color-intensity-coded percentage cells, for visualizing how signup cohorts retain over successive weeks or months.
useWhen: Analyzing how a specific signup or acquisition cohort's engagement decays (or holds) over successive time periods.
Comparing retention curves across multiple cohorts to spot whether a product change improved retention going forward.
avoidWhen: You're showing daily activity intensity over a calendar rather than cohort-by-period retention — use heatmap-calendar instead.
There's only one cohort to show — a simple line chart of retention over time communicates a single curve more directly than a grid.
responsiveBehavior: The table sits in a horizontally scrollable container so additional period columns (W5, W6, ...) can be added without breaking layout on narrow viewports.
accessibility: Marked up as a real <table> with scope="col"/scope="row" headers, so screen readers can announce each cell's cohort and period.
Cells with no data yet (future periods for a recent cohort) show an em dash rather than an empty or zero cell, avoiding a false reading of 0% retention.
Color intensity is reinforced by the percentage text in every cell — retention is never conveyed by color alone.
